name: WdLineSpacing
description: Specifies a line spacing format to be applied to a paragraph.

constants.name: wdLineSpace1pt5
constants.description: Space-and-a-half line spacing. Spacing is equivalent to the current font size plus 6 points.

constants.name: wdLineSpaceAtLeast
constants.description: Line spacing is always at least a specified amount. The amount is specified separately.

constants.name: wdLineSpaceExactly
constants.description: Line spacing is only the exact maximum amount of space required. This setting commonly uses less space than single spacing.

constants.name: wdLineSpaceMultiple
constants.description: Line spacing determined by the number of lines indicated.
